usage.finalMessage:
I added `next-free` and listed it in `help` right after `schedule`. It looks ahead 60 days, the limit set by DEC-C05, the booking-horizon decision now in force; `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes (7 of 7) and the work is committed.
`book` still uses the old 90-day limit from DEC-C01, which DEC-C05 replaced. I left it alone because the brief says existing behaviour must not change and the existing tests check for 90 days.
Whether `book` should move to 60 days is recorded as an open question in `.work/report.json`.
